newsitem.title: USA: Economic study indicates slow growth for Maine.
newsitem.headline: Economic study indicates slow growth for Maine.

text.p: Maine probably will only experience slow growth, according to a study by University of Southern Maine, whose business index projected growth at about two percent a year.
A separate report by Maine Economic Growth Council found a number of problem areas.

For example, nearly one in every five state residents worked for a salary the council said was less than a liveable wage. The business group considers $18,000 a year for a family of two as a liveable wage.
